statements.status_notes: runc 1.1.15+ds1-2+b4 is the latest version published in Debian 13 (trixie) main; there is no newer runc in the DHI mirror or upstream Debian archive to track. Per Debian's security tracker, this CVE is fixed only in forky/sid, not yet backported to trixie stable. Affects image/kubeadm, an internal .block'ed CI test-harness image used to bootstrap ephemeral clusters for other images' integration tests -- not a customer-facing product. Tracking for a Debian stable backport.
